title: Untested call sites: very common names make every call site in a function of that name count as reached.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Raised by the reviewer in round 1 of ork run ork-20261125-184829-ca71 for S564 (discovered from S564):

Untested call sites: very common names make every call site in a function of that name count as reached.
The check matches on `Sel.Name` (`untestedcallsites.go:80`). Every test that calls `t.Run(...)` therefore marks the name `Run` as reached, and the same happens for test-harness methods such as `h.start()`. A product function with one of those names then never counts as an unreached call site. The spec's own fixture names its enclosing function `Run`, and it passes only because its test file never calls `t.Run`. This is part of the documented "by names" limit that the owner accepted. A follow-up could ignore selector calls whose receiver is a parameter of type `*testing.T`, or list the common-name collisions in the section.

Urgency: 1
